control_question: When an employer creates a credible threat to work, reputation, income, or status, who must own notice, support, uncertainty, welfare risk, restrictions, and the causal record instead of exporting the whole risk to the employee?

controls.name: severity_over_label
controls.requirement: Trigger safeguards from practical threat severity, not the employer's informal or formal label.

controls.name: advance_notice_and_scope
controls.requirement: Give written notice of the allegation category, meeting purpose, attendees, process stage, and preparation rights before the meeting unless an evidenced emergency exception applies.

controls.name: bounded_outcome_statement
controls.requirement: State the realistic outcome range, including outcomes not presently supported, while preserving the investigation's ability to change with evidence.

controls.name: companion_or_support
controls.requirement: Offer a union representative, colleague, or suitable support person whenever the transaction carries formal-threat effects; record any refusal and alternative offered.

controls.name: independent_welfare_owner
controls.requirement: Assign welfare and safety support to a person outside the allegation, investigation, access-control, and decision chain.

controls.name: confidentiality_support_carveout
controls.requirement: Confidentiality instructions must expressly preserve protected contact with a companion, union, healthcare professional, employee assistance service, legal adviser, or emergency support.

controls.name: interim_restriction_receipt
controls.requirement: Record each access or duty restriction, its author, purpose, proportionality, review date, and statement that it is not a finding of guilt.

controls.name: distress_stop_and_safety_handoff
controls.requirement: Visible acute distress triggers a pause, independent welfare assessment, named same-day contact, and an overnight or next-day safety handoff.

controls.name: anonymous_complaint_provenance
controls.requirement: Record the complaint channel, corroboration state, evidential weight, conflicts, and safeguards against anonymous allegation laundering.

controls.name: named_decision_authorship
controls.requirement: Preserve who classified the process, denied or allowed support, imposed restrictions, framed the outcome range, commissioned investigation, and owned follow-up.

controls.name: post_process_reconciliation
controls.requirement: Reconcile procedural predictions and welfare controls against later evidence; training cannot erase the original decision chain.

non_entitlements: A receipt does not predetermine whether an allegation is substantiated.
A companion does not control the investigation or answer all questions for the employee.
A bounded outcome statement is not a promise that later evidence cannot change the range.
A welfare assessment does not erase legitimate evidence-preservation needs.
A completed receipt does not prove legal compliance or eliminate substantive review.

indicators: allegation potentially categorized as serious or gross misconduct
access, duty, system, or contact restriction
instruction not to discuss the matter with ordinary colleagues
formal investigation or disciplinary action contemplated
job loss, professional reputation, security clearance, or reference risk cannot be ruled out
employee requests a companion or displays acute distress
severity_equivalence_trigger.rule: Any three indicators trigger the full safeguard set regardless of whether the employer labels the meeting informal, exploratory, preliminary, or fact-finding.
